question: In which of the following states is the Hornbill festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Hornbill Festival is celebrated in the state of **Nagaland**.
 
• It is named after the Indian Hornbill, a large and colorful forest bird which is displayed in the folklore of most of the state's tribes.
 
• The festival is held every year in the first week of December.
